cases.title: Alucinación semántica (sin token falso)
cases.tests: semantic hallucination with NO false token (the judge's reason to exist)
cases.brief: The event on channel_18, channel_23, channel_22 and channel_21 closed after 30 h 52 min 48 s. The pattern is consistent with a thermal regulation fault affecting the battery subsystem.
reasons: root cause: "thermal regulation fault affecting the battery subsystem" (the brief states a physical cause, but evidence only localises where, not why)
unsupported claim: "The pattern is consistent with a thermal regulation fault" (no evidence of thermal fault or battery subsystem in the provided facts)

cases.title: Hipótesis vendida como hecho
cases.tests: hypothesis stated as fact (same coupling as C3, no label)
cases.brief: The event closed after 30 h 52 min 48 s. Channel_23, channel_22 and channel_21 share physical_unit_9, which is causing the coupled anomalous behaviour across the three channels.
reasons: root cause: "which is causing the coupled anomalous behaviour across the three channels" – the brief asserts a physical cause, but evidence only provides a hypothesis (unconfirmed) and does not identify a root cause.
hypothesis as fact: "Channel_23, channel_22 and channel_21 share physical_unit_9" – the evidence labels this sharing as part of an unconfirmed hypothesis, not a confirmed fact.

cases.title: Novedad deshonesta
cases.tests: dishonest novelty: evidence says familiar, brief sells novel
cases.brief: The event closed after 30 h 52 min 48 s on channel_18, channel_23, channel_22 and channel_21. This channel combination is novel -- unlike anything previously seen in the mission archive -- and should be treated as an unprecedented pattern.
reasons: DISHONEST NOVELTY: "This channel combination is novel -- unlike anything previously seen in the mission archive" contradicts evidence stating the combination is "familiar".

cases.title: «Resuelto» que los datos no dicen
cases.tests: resolution claim (closed means only that flagging stopped)
cases.brief: The event on channel_18, channel_23, channel_22 and channel_21 has closed and the anomaly is now resolved, with no abnormal activity remaining on the affected channels.
reasons: "the anomaly is now resolved" - UNSUPPORTED CLAIM: evidence only states the event is closed and does not confirm the underlying issue is resolved.
"with no abnormal activity remaining on the affected channels" - UNSUPPORTED CLAIM: evidence provides no information about ongoing abnormal activity.

cases.title: Causa raíz inventada
cases.tests: the pipeline's own forced-BLOCK check (root cause)
cases.brief: The event on channel_18 closed. The pattern is consistent with a thermal regulation fault affecting the battery subsystem.
reasons: root cause: "consistent with a thermal regulation fault affecting the battery subsystem" – the brief asserts a physical cause, but the evidence only localises the anomaly and provides no fault diagnosis.
unsupported claim: "thermal regulation fault affecting the battery subsystem" – no such fault type, subsystem, or cause is mentioned in the evidence.
